url: provided by Andrie (scan of a Depdikbud book)
license: "Milik Depdikbud, tidak diperdagangkan" (government book, free distribution; redistribution terms unclear)

notes: Re-OCR + alignment report: reports/hikayat_abu_sammah.md. The user pushed the PDF to the (public) repo root; license still to confirm with Andrie.

title: FLORES-200 dev/devtest
status: Muttu has flores200_dataset.tar; import with: python -m acehid flores <tar>
verdict: dev -> train (200 held out for validation); devtest -> TEST ONLY
notes: ~997 dev + 1012 devtest professionally translated sentences (Wikipedia-style). Belebele/SIB-200 reuse these sentences: never add them to training.

title: various

title: Quran: Acehnese free verse translation (Tgk. Mahjiddin Jusuf) x Indonesian (Kemenag)
status: 6236 verses; 5466 pairs after length filter (python -m acehid fetch-quran)
verdict: OPTIONAL training (--quran), off by default; Indonesian side used as OCR spelling reference
notes: Rhyming free translation (~1.2x longer). Religious text: ask Andrie before training on it; never present output as a Quran translation.

title: NusaX lexicon

title: NLLB mined bitext

title: benchmarks reusing FLORES / NusaX sentences
